name: Valentina
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a soft brown shadow root that melts into sandy beige blonde through the mid-lengths. Fine ribbons of darker blonde add depth, while creamy blonde pieces brighten the hairline and softly frame the face. Warm honey tones become more prominent through the lower lengths, giving her a sun-kissed finish.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch her up after unboxing if needed.
